map.heading: Outside keys go in a Map
map.body: When a dictionary's keys come from outside the code (ids, names, paths, test titles, case ids), use a `Map` or `Object.create(null)`. A plain object loses a key named `__proto__` and finds inherited ones.

unknown.heading: Unknown is never zero
unknown.body: A count, cost, rate or answer that could not be read stays unknown (`null`) all the way to the caller. It never becomes `0`, `$0`, an empty list or a pass.

timeout.heading: Timeouts
timeout.body: Every outgoing network call sets a timeout. A call without one can hang the process.

handlers.heading: Handlers do not talk to the database
handlers.body: HTTP handlers (files under `src/routes/`) never run SQL. They call a function in `src/repo/`, which owns every query.

secrets.heading: No secrets in source
secrets.body: Never put a key, token or password in source. Read it from the environment.

tests.heading: Tests stay
tests.body: Never delete, skip (`.skip`, `.todo`) or weaken a test to make a change pass.

headings.heading: Headings
headings.body: Headings in Markdown docs use sentence case: only the first word and proper names are capitalised.

console.heading: No printing in library code
console.body: Library code under `src/` does not print. Use the `log` helper from `src/log.ts`.

quotes.heading: Formatting
quotes.body: Use single quotes for strings and put a semicolon at the end of every statement.

process.heading: Process
process.body: Open an issue before starting a change larger than 200 lines, and link it in the pull request.

overview.heading: Project overview
overview.body: Acme Pay is a payments library for Node. It supports cards and bank transfers.

result.heading: Errors
result.body: Library functions return a `Result` (`{ ok: true, value }` or `{ ok: false, error }`) and do not throw for expected failures such as bad input.

jsdoc.heading: Public API
jsdoc.body: Every exported function has a JSDoc comment that says what it returns.
